**Performance: PASS WITH NOTES** at `b901a64fb863599bc787dfa490ba22b1f15c2bb1`.

Delta from cost-passed `96f9f41a676e2d41868245715c719f589b757fb8`, output `a4202415da4a8f53b54108b91affc60fbac8db9b`. The sole intervening commit changes renderers, two existing CLI test cases, one new CLI case and one new HTTP case. No product mutation, store/network query, process-launch site, writer commit, timer, poll or sweep is added.

**Per invocation:** requests, outputs, holding/lineage receipts, claims seats, reshape prime and directory prompts/suggestions add grammar checks within their existing row traversals. The extracted `shown` helper replaces the former directory-local closure; it does not introduce another pass. New `project` accepts at most 48 bytes and checks nonempty lowercase-alphanumeric hyphen-separated runs. Other accepted bounds remain name/word32, seat64, subject96, message/request128 and head40.

Template drift adds bounded role32/project48/template32 checks per behind-template row, plus at most nine string-version digits after an optional `v`. It constructs a command only for printable keys; it no longer copies/quotes arbitrary role/project strings with `shell_word`. The project check repeats for each such row, not once globally. Numeric version formatting and the final command/fallback allocate short strings.

The designated-prime note adds a seat check inside the existing matching-prompt loop. This runs before the suggest/hidden-prompt partition, so the cost is per constructed directory view with that prompt, not exclusively when `--suggest` displays it. No new heartbeat, inbox, activity or watchdog schedule is introduced; scaling follows actual view/CLI invocations and displayed rows, not a new per-seat tick.

**Inherited P185-N001 remains:** invalid fields and invalid string versions call full-input `chars().count()`. Grammar caps bound accepted checks, not malformed-input CPU or the existing JSON/list cloning. Repeated appearances can repeat that scan. Most `shown(...).into_owned()` calls replace an already-owned `text(...)`; direct formatting can borrow. One extra valid-role copy is added in `holding_name`: the existing owned role is rendered and converted to another owned String, at most 32 bytes when valid; the earlier raw role/path preparation remains.

The request close reason now visits at most 500 input scalars plus one lookahead and escapes them into a quoted String. This bounds newly displayed reason preparation, not escaped output bytes or the prior request-row clone. Existing uncapped listing sizes and raw `--json` values are unchanged. Claims free text/F142 is explicitly outside this delta; this is not a correctness/security clearance.

**Exact-head CI:** [42495395141](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42495395141), attempt 1, successful Rust job `128776522155`. Its upload log names artifact **13623017449**, whose metadata pins the same full head. JUnit contains **2,254 executed cases passed**, zero failures/errors/skips; nextest separately reports five skipped. Verified the extended full-directory formatter case, drift command case, new plain-receipts case, hostile-prime HTTP case and all six spawn guards. Rust lint, Node22/24 and replacement delivers checks succeed; the superseded delivers run was cancelled. W1-W17 mutations are author-reported, not rerun.

Detached shared worktree and GitHub heads agree, clean and CLEAN. Source review and CI receipts only: no local build, test, mutation, live view or performance probe. No new cost blocker; prior scan/fence qualifications remain.
